description: The adversarial review identified performance-gate detection limits that remain after the decimal-boundary fix: a query can double from 4.4 ms to 8.8 ms yet stay below the 7 ms per-query floor, while the +13.2 ms total increase stays below the 82 ms aggregate floor. A baseline measured on a slower runner class can also weaken sensitivity, and the current comparison does not include run.total_duration_ms, so orchestration overhead is outside its signal. The review called these explicit detection limits, not patch-introduced defects. Assess and record whether these omissions are accepted policy or product gaps requiring additional signals; preserve protection against host-noise false positives.
